title: selaginella bodinieri var. omeiensis
intro: Selaginella bodinieri var. omeiensis, commonly known as the Omei spikemoss, is a species of spikemoss in the family Selaginellaceae, native to China. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and pneumonia. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella bodinieri var. omeiensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
